{{Quote|Fire everything we have at them!|the Skakoan commander|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
This '''Skakoan''' male commanded a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist fleet]] during the [[Battle of Cavamina Minor]]. [[Attuma Duum|Duum]], who was playing both sides in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars,]] had seeded six hundred thousand [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] around the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When the CIS warships reverted from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], they sustained significant damage. Seeing an opposing [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] instead of the merchant convoy Duum had promised him, the Separatist fleet commander ordered his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to open fire.
